sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A large tree of mainland Southeast Asian tropical forests, reaching about 40 m. It occurs in lowland humid forest and alluvial areas.

sections.title: Leaves and fruit
sections.text: The simple leaves are broad and alternate. The dry fruit has two greatly enlarged wing-like sepals that spin and slow its fall, aiding wind dispersal.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: The timber is used in the region. The sources consulted do not document reliable food use for this species.
